def probability(x, n):
    return 1.5 * x / n * (n - x) / (n - 1) * (n - x - 1) / (n - 2) + \
           3.0 * x / n * (x - 1) / (n - 1) * (n - x) / (n - 2) + \
           1.0 * x / n * (x - 1) / (n - 1) * (x - 2) / (n - 2)

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    parts = line.split()
    n = int(parts[0])
    p = float(parts[1])
    x = 0
    while probability(x, n) < p:
        x += 1
    print(x)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
